newsitem.title: USA: Ex-Senate candidate charged with planning murder.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Senate candidate charged with planning murder.

text.p: Police Monday arrested Ruthann Aron, a developer who in 1994 was a Republican candidate for the Senate from Maryland, on charges she tried to hire a hit man to kill her husband and a Baltimore lawyer.

Aron, 54, was arrested as part of an elaborate sting operation set up after an informant called police and said Aron was seeking names of people to do some "work" for her, and that she wanted some people "eliminated," police said.

Montgomery County police sent in an undercover police officer who posed as a hit man, and Aron earlier on Monday dropped off a package containing a $500 "downpayment" for the job, Lt. Col. Fred Ailes told reporters.
The targets were her husband Barry Aron and Arthur Kahn, a Baltimore lawyer who represented two lenders who won a lawsuit against Aron for fraud in a real estate deal.
Aron last her bid for the nomination to William Brock, who later lost the race to Democratic incumbent Paul Sarbanes.
